videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「矽磊晶層生長」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Silicon epitaxial growth. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「區分磊晶與沉積」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Distinguish epitaxy from deposition requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「厚度均勻圖」列為查證任務：檢查結果是否能支持「中心邊緣與方位點都需納入採樣。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Map thickness uniformity: Check whether the evidence supports: Sampling should include radial and azimuthal positions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
videos.rights: External official embed/link only. Copyright remains with the publisher; no download or rehosting license is claimed.

related.transfer: 磊晶成長與選擇性 SiGe 共用表面成核及傳質問題，並連到應變設計。
related.transferEn: Epitaxy and selective SiGe share nucleation and transport questions and connect to strain design.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷；「矽鍺選擇性磊晶」則以選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects; Selective silicon-germanium epitaxy treats selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出矽磊晶層生長與矽鍺選擇性磊晶之間的材料或資料交接
用「區分磊晶與沉積」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷的觀察，說明還需哪個矽鍺選擇性磊晶證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Silicon epitaxial growth and Selective silicon-germanium epitaxy
Use distinguish epitaxy from deposition to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects and state which additional Selective silicon-germanium epitaxy evidence is needed for acceptance
related.title: 矽鍺選擇性磊晶

related.transfer: 磊晶成長與選擇性 SiGe 共用表面成核及傳質問題，並連到應變設計。
related.transferEn: Epitaxy and selective SiGe share nucleation and transport questions and connect to strain design.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷；「應變矽通道整合」則以應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects; Strained-silicon channel integration treats strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出矽磊晶層生長與應變矽通道整合之間的材料或資料交接
用「反應控制區」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷的觀察，說明還需哪個應變矽通道整合證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Silicon epitaxial growth and Strained-silicon channel integration
Use identify reaction-limited growth to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects and state which additional Strained-silicon channel integration evidence is needed for acceptance
related.title: 應變矽通道整合

courses.summaryEn: Silicon epitaxial growth explores thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects. The map locates a public institutional reference to explain research and supply-chain roles. This course draws on multiple original sources and does not claim an exclusive invention site or actual production location.
courses.connection: 相近課程可轉移的是膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷的證據推理；各材料、幾何與熱限制仍需重新設定。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the evidence reasoning around thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to related courses while redefining material, geometry and thermal constraints.
